_provenance.note: LLM reading of the lens token tables; not a measurement

axes.label: weekend (Saturday/Sunday) ↔ midweek (Wednesday)
axes.rationale: All three lenses put Sunday, Saturday, Sundays and weekend at the negative end, and 'nesday' (the Wednesday fragment) heads the positive end in the logit and tuned lenses; the remaining positive tokens are noise.

axes.label: Friday ↔ Monday/Tuesday
axes.rationale: All three lenses consistently put Monday, Mondays, MON and Tuesday at the positive end and Fri, Friday and Fridays at the negative end, giving a start-of-week vs end-of-week contrast.

axes.label: non-day formatting tokens ↔ Friday
axes.rationale: The Jacobian lens clearly puts Friday, Fri and Fridays at the positive end, and the logit and tuned lenses each show only ' Fridays' among fragments; the negative end in every lens is whitespace, single letters or fragments.
